tasks.title: Bill input and display
tasks.description: Implement the bill amount input field with currency symbol and validation
acceptanceCriteria: User can enter a bill amount using the numeric input field
User sees a dollar sign ($) before the input value
User sees the bill amount displayed in the summary section
User sees the input field highlighted when focused

tasks.title: Tip percentage selection
tasks.description: Implement the four preset tip buttons with visual selection state
acceptanceCriteria: User can tap any of the four tip percentage buttons (15%, 18%, 20%, 25%)
User sees the selected button highlighted with the teal accent color
User sees only one tip percentage selected at a time
User sees the selected tip percentage labeled in the summary

tasks.title: Tip and total calculation
tasks.description: Calculate and display tip amount and final total based on bill and tip percentage
acceptanceCriteria: User sees the calculated tip amount update when bill or tip percentage changes
User sees the final total amount displayed prominently in large teal numbers
User sees all amounts formatted with dollar sign and two decimal places
User sees calculations update immediately without needing to tap a calculate button

tasks.title: Navigation between calculator and settings
tasks.description: Implement navigation from calculator to settings and back
acceptanceCriteria: User can tap the settings button to navigate to the settings screen
User can tap the back button to return to the calculator screen
User sees their entered bill amount preserved when returning from settings

tasks.title: Default tip percentage setting
tasks.description: Allow users to set and persist their preferred default tip percentage
acceptanceCriteria: User can select one of four tip percentages (15%, 18%, 20%, 25%) as their default
User sees the selected default marked with a filled radio indicator
User sees their chosen default tip pre-selected when opening the app
User's default tip preference persists after closing and reopening the app

tasks.title: Rounding options setting
tasks.description: Allow users to configure how the final total is rounded
acceptanceCriteria: User can choose from four rounding options (none, nearest dollar, up to dollar, nearest $5)
User sees the selected rounding option marked with a filled radio indicator
User sees the final total rounded according to their selected preference
User sees rounding applied only to the final total, not to the bill or tip amounts
User's rounding preference persists after closing and reopening the app

tasks.title: Build calculator screen structure
tasks.description: Create the main calculator screen with header, bill input section, tip percentage buttons grid, and summary display area. Implement all styling including the phone-sized frame, clean light theme, and layout.
acceptanceCriteria: User sees a phone-sized calculator screen with a header showing 'Tip Calculator' and a settings button
User sees a bill input field with a dollar sign
User sees four tip percentage buttons (15%, 18%, 20%, 25%) arranged in a 2x2 grid
User sees a summary section showing bill, tip, and total labels

tasks.title: Implement bill amount input
tasks.description: Make the bill input functional with numeric validation, decimal support, and proper formatting. Handle edge cases like empty input, zero, and invalid characters.
acceptanceCriteria: User can type a bill amount using numbers and decimal point
User sees the entered amount displayed in the bill input field
User cannot enter non-numeric characters (except decimal point)

tasks.title: Implement tip button selection
tasks.description: Make tip percentage buttons interactive with single-selection behavior and visual active state. When a button is clicked, it becomes active and others become inactive.
acceptanceCriteria: User can tap any tip percentage button and see it become highlighted
User sees only one tip button highlighted at a time
User sees the previously selected button become unhighlighted when selecting a new one

tasks.title: Implement tip calculation and display
tasks.description: Calculate tip amount and total based on bill amount and selected tip percentage. Update the summary display in real-time whenever bill or tip changes. Display values with proper currency formatting.
acceptanceCriteria: User sees the tip amount update when they change the bill amount
User sees the tip amount update when they select a different tip percentage
User sees the total amount update when either bill or tip changes
User sees all amounts displayed with dollar signs and two decimal places

tasks.title: Build settings screen structure
tasks.description: Create the settings screen with header, back button, and two sections: Default Tip and Rounding. Implement all styling and radio button UI elements.
acceptanceCriteria: User sees a settings screen with a back button and 'Settings' title
User sees a 'Default Tip' section with four radio options (15%, 18%, 20%, 25%)
User sees a 'Rounding' section with four radio options (no rounding, round to nearest dollar, round up to dollar, round to nearest $5)
User sees descriptive text under each section explaining what it does

tasks.title: Implement default tip setting
tasks.description: Make the default tip radio buttons functional with single-selection behavior and visual selected state.
acceptanceCriteria: User can tap any default tip option and see it become selected
User sees only one default tip option selected at a time
User sees the radio indicator fill when an option is selected

tasks.title: Implement rounding setting
tasks.description: Make the rounding radio buttons functional with single-selection behavior and visual selected state.
acceptanceCriteria: User can tap any rounding option and see it become selected
User sees only one rounding option selected at a time
User sees the radio indicator fill when an option is selected

tasks.title: Implement screen navigation
tasks.description: Connect the calculator and settings screens with navigation. The settings button on calculator opens settings, and the back button on settings returns to calculator.
acceptanceCriteria: User can tap the settings button on the calculator and see the settings screen appear
User can tap the back button on the settings screen and see the calculator screen appear

tasks.title: Apply rounding to total
tasks.description: Apply the selected rounding option to the final total amount. Implement all four rounding modes and update the display when rounding changes.
acceptanceCriteria: User sees the total remain exact when 'No rounding' is selected
User sees the total rounded to the nearest whole dollar when 'Round to nearest dollar' is selected
User sees the total rounded up to the next whole dollar when 'Round up to dollar' is selected
User sees the total rounded to the nearest $5 when 'Round to nearest $5' is selected
User sees the tip amount adjust to reflect the rounding difference

tasks.title: Persist settings to storage
tasks.description: Save the user's selected default tip percentage and rounding option to local storage whenever they change. Load saved settings when the app opens.
acceptanceCriteria: User's default tip selection is remembered when they close and reopen the app
User's rounding selection is remembered when they close and reopen the app

tasks.title: Apply default tip on launch
tasks.description: When the calculator loads, automatically select the user's saved default tip percentage. If no default is saved, select a sensible default (e.g., 18%).
acceptanceCriteria: User sees their saved default tip percentage already selected when opening the calculator
User sees 18% selected when opening the app for the first time

tasks.title: Preserve calculator state during navigation
tasks.description: Maintain the bill amount and selected tip percentage when user navigates to settings and back.
acceptanceCriteria: User sees their entered bill amount unchanged after going to settings and returning
User sees their selected tip percentage unchanged after going to settings and returning (unless they changed the default)
